request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fur, fabric and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

ONE FLOWER. A single large bright YELLOW flower with a green stem and two leaves grows alone from dark soil, photographed close up against a soft plain green background. It is the only subject and fills the photo. No people, no animals, no boats, no buildings. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
